text: CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: CRWD) is a US-listed cybersecurity company with a dispersed register dominated by index funds; co-founder and CEO George Kurtz is the most prominent individual holder. There is no state shareholder. Human-rights relevance is thin - its record event (the July 2024 global outage) is operational rather than rights-based.

source.name: CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. DEF 14A 2026, 'Security Ownership of Certain Beneficial Owners and Management' (SEC)
source.quote: each person, or group of affiliated persons, who beneficially owned more than 5% of our common stock
